description_en: Queries the carrier-side status of an IoT card for intelligent diagnostics
description_zh: 智能诊断-查询卡在运营商侧状态
name: GetCardRealStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page in the IoT SIM Service console
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en: The MSISDN of the IoT card
parameters.name: msisdn

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for polling the query result
parameters.help_zh: 轮询查询结果的唯一标识
parameters.name: serial_no

Code.description_en: The API response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Gprs.description_en:
The network service status. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Gprs.description_zh:
网络服务状态。

true：开通。

false：关闭

Iccid.description_en: The ICCID of the card. If the requested ICCID is for the primary card in a multi-card setup, the ICCID of the secondary card is returned
Iccid.description_zh: 卡的ICCID，当请求ICCID为多网卡主卡时，此处返回子卡ICCID

Online.description_en:
The online status. Valid values:
true: Online.
false: Offline
Online.description_zh:
在线状态。

true：在线。

false：不在线

SerialNo.description_en:
The unique identifier for polling the query result.

Note:

The carrier capability for this API is limited and query results take time to return. Therefore, this parameter is used in combination with the polling capability.

After the initial request, if the status is not successful, this parameter is returned in the response. You can then use this parameter to poll for the result
SerialNo.description_zh:
轮询查询结果的唯一标识。

说明：

1、因该接口运营商能力较弱，查询结果需时，故结合轮询能力使用。

2、在首次请求后，如Status未成功，则返回参数中会带此数据，再用此数据进行结果轮询

Status.description_en:
The status of the query result. Valid values:
SUCCESS: Successful.
FAILURE: Failed.
PROCESSING: Processing
Status.description_zh:
查询结果状态： 

SUCCESS：成功

FAILURE：失败

PROCESSING：处理中

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The localized error message displayed based on the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is an identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。 false：调用失败
